spans.s:
Niggard,Ⓒs.ⒹkfpaRaH, kzudraH, kadaryaH.
Ⓝ[Niggard]ly,Ⓒa.ⒹkfpaRa, kzudra, kadarya, tyAgavimuKa (KI f.), badDamuzwi.
Ⓔadv.ⒹkfpaRavat, alpavyayena.
Ⓝ[Niggard]ness,Ⓒs.ⒹkArpaRyaM, kadaryatA; See Miser, &c.

Night,Ⓒs.ⒹrAtri-trI, rajaniH-nI, kzapA, niSA, viBAvarI, Sa(SA)rvarI, yAminI, triyAmA, niSITinI, kzaRadA, tamasvinI, tamiH-mI-mA, (all f.); ‘a dark n(ight)’ tamisrA, tAmasI; ‘moonlight n(ight)’ jyOtsnI, jyotizmatI; ‘by n(ight)’, ‘at n(ight)’ rAtrO, niSi, naktaM, dozA; ‘number of n(ight)s’ gaRarAtraM; ‘beginning of n(ight)’ pradozaH, rajanImuKaM, niSAmuKaM; ‘n(ight) and day’ rAtriMdivaM, naktaMdivaM; ‘a n(ight) and 2 days’ pakziRI; ‘sitting up at n(ight)’ rAtri-jAgaraH; ‘n(ight)-attack’ sOptikaM, sOptikAkramaH; ‘n(ight)-blindness’ rAtryaMDatA; ‘n(ight)-dress’ rAtriveSaH; ‘n(ight)-fall’ pradozaH, niSA-rajanI-muKaM, saMDyAkAlaH, rAtriyogaH; ‘n(ight)-hag’ rAtricarA, rAtryawA; ‘n(ight)-man’ Kala-mala-pUH; ‘n(ight)-mare’ duHsvapnaH, kusvapnaH; ‘n(ight)-shade’ nidigDikA, spfSI, vyAGrI, bfhatI, kaMwakA-rikA, pracodanI, kulI, kzudrA, duHsparSA, rAzwrikA^1; ‘n(ight)-wandering’ niSAcara, rAtri(triM)cara; ‘n(ight)-watch’ nagararakziRaH (pl.); yAmaH, praharaH.
Ⓝ[Night]ly,Ⓒa.ⒹnESa (SI f.), dozAtana (nI f.), (s.) in comp.; ‘n(ightly) watch’ rAtrijAgaraRaM.
Ⓔadv.ⒹrAtrO, niSi, naktaM.
Ⓑ
 2 pratirAtraM, niSiniSi, rAtrO rAtrO.
